description: Source code for the Visualizer class in Android's media framework, implementing audio visualization effects including waveform and FFT capture, with threading and callback mechanisms.
external_methods: AudioEffect(SL_IID_VISUALIZATION, NULL, priority, cbf, user, sessionId)

classes.name: Visualizer
classes.description: Android media effect class for audio visualization, supporting waveform and FFT capture, with threading for periodic data collection.

classes.name: Visualizer::CaptureThread
classes.description: Inner thread class responsible for periodic audio data capture for visualization.

methods.name: Visualizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Visualizer effect with parameters and default settings.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the visualizer effect, managing the capture thread accordingly.

methods.name: setCaptureCallBack
methods.description: Sets the callback function for waveform and FFT data capture at specified rate and flags.

methods.name: setCaptureSize
methods.description: Configures the size of the capture buffer, ensuring it is a power of two within allowed limits.

methods.name: setScalingMode
methods.description: Sets the scaling mode for visualization (normalized or as played).

methods.name: getWaveForm
methods.description: Retrieves the current waveform data if visualizer is enabled.

methods.name: getFft
methods.description: Computes and retrieves the FFT of the current waveform.

methods.name: doFft
methods.description: Performs FFT computation on waveform data.

methods.name: periodicCapture
methods.description: Called periodically by the capture thread to collect waveform and FFT data and invoke callback.

methods.name: initCaptureSize
methods.description: Initializes the capture buffer size from effect parameters.

methods.name: controlStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in control status, resetting parameters as needed.
